lead: A plan field is patched, not retyped: `## plan-edit: <Field>` with `--- old` / `--- new`.
body: `## plan: <Field>` still replaces a field whole, but a replacement over 1.5 KB whose text is mostly already on disk is refused as a retype, because re-emitting a field by hand is where a paragraph gets silently dropped. Quote the `--- old` fragment as the field *reads* — one single-spaced paragraph, however it is wrapped on disk — so it matches exactly once; a deliberate trim to under 60% of the size, or a real rewrite, still goes through as a `## plan:`.
